A privacy-reviewed audit of partner failure reasons against underlying event records.
An overlap map for riders, routes, hubs, and carriers before selecting an assignment unit.
A pre-registered primary outcome, power/MDE, stopping rule, and customer, rider, seller, service, and privacy guardrails.
